verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid CLI/exec and delegated task workflow (delegate a task, review diff, merge) directly supports autonomous bug-fix style workflows, and features like tiered autonomy and readiness-fix show automated diagnosis/fix loops on repos. However, evidence is all first-party docs describing general task delegation and repo-readiness fixes rather than a documented end-to-end 'given a bug report, agent diagnoses root cause and submits a fix' workflow, and there's no independent/hands-on validation. Missing for 10: a concrete bug-report-to-fix case study or benchmark, independent corroboration of diagnostic accuracy, and explicit documentation of root-cause analysis capability distinct from generic task execution.
